title: Patch: Stinkyscape balance pass — Starship tag, Marketplace prices, Weapons and twenty cards
thread:
**Issue #3000 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3000: Patch: Stinkyscape balance pass — Starship tag, Marketplace prices, Weapons and twenty cards
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

The owner's balance pass, mostly over Stinkyscape: Starships, Dormant and Flashback, the Marketplace, every Weapon and about twenty cards, plus three changes to how cards look. "Now" below is today's `crates/cards/catalog.json` and `crates/engine/src/config.rs` on `main`. A **~** number is a target, not an exact figure: the shop's existing price spread (`MARKETPLACE_PRICE_SPREAD_DIVISOR`) still applies.

Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` before any card change (CLAUDE.md rule 10). Every number goes in as a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). Each decision the spec doesn't already make gets a ruling note in this issue's block (rule 3). The parts are independent enough to split (labelled `bot:fullsend`); a suggested split is at the end.

### 1. Mechanics: Starship, Dormant, Flashback

- **Starship goes from a keyword to a tag.** Today `Starship` is a keyword (`{"kind": "Starship"}`) on the three Drone Battleship tokens, and the Dormant Starship / launched Starship is tracked via `StaticFlags.starshipHull`. New rules:
  - Starship is a **tag**, like `Human` or `Jlockeed`.
  - Every Starship **innately has Flying and Ranged**, and **the Flying and Ranged icons show on every Starship card** (the Dormant Starship and a launched one, on the board and in any card view), just as on any card that has those keywords.
  - Starship Pieces **still fuse into it** as they do today, along with everything else that targets "your Starship" or "your Dormant Starship" (Ultra Capacitor, Starfleet Commander, Preemptive Strike, Call to Chaos (Scape Edition), Prepare For Liftoff, Spacerace cards, Yamato Cannon, Sea Doctrine and so on). Re-key them on the tag.
  - `STARSHIP_NAMES` already draws names by tag; check that it still works.
- **Launching a Starship costs (4).** Today it costs (3) (`STARSHIP_LAUNCH_COST`, R1852003). Update the Dormant Starship's text to "Activate: Pay (4) to launch this." and every text or ruling that quotes the (3). Prepare For Liftoff's "costs (0)" stays.
- **Drone Battleships are no longer Starships.** Shield, Propagation and Meltdown Layer (`stinkyscape-t-shield-layer`, `-t-propagation-layer`, `-t-meltdown-layer`) lose Starship and gain the keywords **Flying** and **Ranged**. Everything else on them stays. Anything that treats them as "your Starship" (launch, fusing pieces in, Starship-only effects) stops applying to them.
- **A card that awakens from Dormant loses Dormant for good.** Played again from the graveyard, Reborn, or summoned again, it isn't Dormant a second time. This covers Imprisoned Ship Smith (`stinkyscape-017`), Imprisoned Cosmality (`-019`) and the Dormant Starship (`-t-dormant-starship`), and any card made Dormant by an effect.
- **A card played through Flashback keeps Flashback**, so it can be flashed back again. This covers Moonberry (`-021`), Prepare For Liftoff (`-144`) and cards that get Flashback from Sanctum (`-152`). Same reasoning as Dormant: the keyword shouldn't be lost on the replay.

### 2. Cosmetic (the client, `apps/web/src/cards/`)

- **A card that has a Miner (`stinkyscape-062`…`066`) or a Weapon fused into it keeps its own original art.** The fused piece doesn't replace it.
- **Fusing into a Dormant Starship or a launched Starship doesn't rename it.** It keeps its name: "Dormant Starship", or the name drawn at launch.
- **Full-art cards look full-art on the board too**, with their name below the art.

### 3. The Marketplace (`crates/engine/src/marketplace.rs`, R1853000–R1853003)

- **It offers 4 cards a turn**, not 3 (`MARKETPLACE_OFFERS_PER_TURN`).
- **New price curve** (Credits by the card's cost; today it's 5 for (0), then 10 per mana up to (4) and 5 per mana after that):

  | Cost | (0) | (1) | (2) | (3) | (4) | (5) | (6) | (7) | each mana after |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | Price | ~8 | ~15 | ~25 | ~35 | ~45 | ~60 | ~75 | ~90 | +~15 |

  That is: 8 for (0), 15 for (1), +10 per mana from (2) to (4), then +15 per mana past (4) (the extra 5).
- **Resource cards show in braces, `{N}`, how many Credits they sell for this turn**, on their face. That's the per-turn quote `market.quotes` already computes (R1853002).
- **A card bought from the Marketplace costs (0).**
- **Buffed and Nerfed offers.** Each card offered rolls:
  - **Buff:** a 20% chance to be Buffed once. A Buff is the §6.3 Buff, the one Book of Buff (`classicplus-071`) gives. A Buffed card costs ~20% more Credits. The roll repeats while it succeeds: 20% once, 4% twice, 0.8% three times and so on. Each Buff adds another ~20% to the price.
  - **Nerf:** a 10% chance to be Nerfed once, the §6.3 Nerf. A Nerfed card costs ~15% fewer Credits. It also repeats while it succeeds: 10% once, 1% twice and so on. (The note's "4% … buffed twice" on this line was a slip for Nerf.)
  - **An offer is never both Buffed and Nerfed.** Suggested: roll the Buff first, and roll the Nerf only when no Buff landed. The builder decides and writes a ruling note.
  - The existing Radiant roll (`MARKETPLACE_RADIANT_CHANCE`, 2× price) stays as it is. The Buff/Nerf price change applies on top of it.

### 4. Every Weapon (tag `Weapon`, 16 cards)

Attack stays 0; Health changes:

| Rarity | Now (base / Radiant) | New (base / Radiant) | Cards |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rare | 0/4 / 0/8 | **0/2 / 0/4** | Beam v3, Repeater v3, Cannon v3, Flak v3, Rush Token Launcher, Fruit Launcher |
| Epic | 0/6 / 0/12 | **0/3 / 0/6** | Beam v4, Repeater v4, Cannon v4, Flak v4, Jade Launcher, Book Launcher |
| Legendary | 0/8 / 0/16 | **0/4 / 0/8** | Beam v5, Repeater v5, Cannon v5, Flak v5 |

The four Launchers carry the `Weapon` tag, so they're included.

### 5. Cards

| Card | Now | New |
|---|---|---|
| **Twinspell** (`core-079`, Field Spell) | "Your next Spell gains Echo +{echoGain}. Then this goes to the graveyard." (base +1, Radiant +2) | Base: "**Activate: The next Spell you play this turn gains Echo +1. Then this goes to the graveyard.**" Radiant: "**Activate: The next Spell you play this turn gains Echo +1.**" (stays on the field, so it can be used once each turn). Radiant `echoGain` 2 → 1. "Goes to the graveyard" rather than "tribute": it's the card's own current wording. |
| **Jlockeed's Missile Pod** (`stinkyscape-129`) | Attack ÷ {divisor}, rounded down | Rounded **up** |
| **Echo** (`classic-057`) | Text of the last Spell either player played | When no Spell has been played yet, it has the text of **The Coin** (`core-t-coin`) |
| **Circadian Fullcycler** (`stinkyscape-047`) | (3) | **(4)** |
| **Rod of Ages** (`stinkyscape-016`) | Quickdraw tag; Flying; "Upon reaching 10 keywords, make this Radiant." | Loses **Quickdraw** and **Flying** (Radiant face too); "Upon reaching **12** keywords" |
| **True Craft a Card** (`meditative-017`) | Craft points from `CRAFT_POINTS_BASE` + `CRAFT_POINTS_PER_MANA` (R880–R883) | **~20% fewer points** for True Craft a Card only. Plain Craft a Card (`core-099`) doesn't use these points; check whether anything else does before changing the shared constants. |
| **Death by 1000 cuts** (`meditative-005`) | Echo X; "X is {echo} times your max mana" (base 2, Radiant 4) | X is {echo} times your **current** mana, i.e. what's unspent after paying for this, so played with exactly 1 mana it cuts **once** (X = 0). Reword so that's clear. **Every echo hits the first cast's target, with no new target prompt.** If that target dies, the remaining echoes fizzle. |
| **In a hurry** (`traininggrounds-015`) | (2), Summon 3 | **(3), Summon 4** (`tokens` base and Radiant 3 → 4) |
| **MC Tech** (`classic-040`) | 4 permanents (`threshold` 4) | **5** permanents |
| **Drone Hanger** (`stinkyscape-168`, Field Spell) | (2); "Start of turn: Summon a Drone Interceptor." | **(3)**; "**Activate:** Summon a (Radiant) Drone Interceptor." |
| **ZolarKeth** (`stinkyscape-026`) | 2/9 · 4/18; the option gains "Activate: Summon a random Starship Piece." | **2/7 · 4/14**; the option gains "**End of turn:** Summon a random (Radiant) Starship Piece." |
| **Jlockeed's J15 Fighter** (`classicplus-051`) | Ranged, Flying, Rush, can't be attacked | Gains **Can't Defend** (both faces) |
| **Ultra Capacitor** (`stinkyscape-133`) | (2) | **(1)** |
| **In Too Deep** (`classic-090`, `subsystems/quests.rs`) | Today's quest thresholds | Every quest path ~**20% harder** (raise each threshold ~20%). The **final quest before the "Your Units have Indestructible" reward** gets a clearly higher bump than the rest. |
| **The Propagation's Hornet** (`stinkyscape-092`) | 3/4 · 6/8 | **3/3 · 6/6** |
| **Asphyxiants Cloud** (`stinkyscape-013`) | Poisonous (Radiant: Echo 1, Poisonous); "Your next Spell this turn has Poisonous. Deal {damage} damage to all enemies. Draw {draw}." | Base: "**Flashback** / Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Your next Spell this turn has Poisonous." Radiant: "**Flashback** / Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Your next Spell this turn has Poisonous." It loses its own Poisonous, the draw and the Radiant's Echo 1. |
| **Doom Shroom** (`classicplus-001`) | (3) | **(4)** |
| **Rush Token Launcher** (`stinkyscape-140`) | Summons its Rush Token into an open zone | **Can summon its Rush Token into a Locked zone** |

## Acceptance

- [ ] Starship is a tag. Every Starship has Flying and Ranged, and the view (`view_for`) and the client show the Flying and Ranged icons on every Starship card (web unit test plus a screenshot). Starship Pieces still fuse into the Dormant Starship, and every "your Starship" card still finds it (tests in each touched card's file and the engine's rules tests).
- [ ] `STARSHIP_LAUNCH_COST` is 4, and the Dormant Starship's text and the rulings say (4).
- [ ] The three Drone Battleships have no Starship, have Flying and Ranged, and aren't launched, fused into or counted as "your Starship".
- [ ] A Dormant card that has awakened is not Dormant when played from the graveyard, Reborn or summoned again (test for each of the three Dormant cards).
- [ ] A card played through Flashback still has Flashback and can be flashed back again (Moonberry, Prepare For Liftoff, a Sanctum-granted card).
- [ ] Client: a card with a Miner or Weapon fused in keeps its own art; a fused-into (Dormant) Starship keeps its name; full-art cards render full-art on the board with the name below (web unit tests; screenshots in the pull request).
- [ ] Marketplace: 4 offers a turn; base prices follow the table within the spread; Resources show `{N}` Credits; a bought card costs (0); the Buff/Nerf rolls repeat as described, change the price by ~+20% / ~−15% per roll, and never both land on one offer (seeded tests).
- [ ] All 16 Weapons have the new Health on both faces.
- [ ] Every card in section 5 matches its new column, with base and Radiant tests in its script file per its set's must-pass table (CLAUDE.md rule 6). Death by 1000 cuts: one cast at 1 mana, and echoes on the same target with no new prompt.
- [ ] Each new decision has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, with a test named after it, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] Pending fragment(s) from `cargo jackioh patches "<title>"` claim every card that plays differently. `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`, `catalog check`, `patches check`, `golden check`, `fuzz --seeds 200` and `gate` pass, and `rust`, `web`, `e2e smoke`, `db` and `bot selftest` are green.

## Suggested split (for the fullsend)

1. Starship tag (with the Flying/Ranged icons), launch cost (4), Drone Battleships (section 1, first three bullets).
2. Dormant and Flashback kept on replay (section 1, last two bullets).
3. Marketplace (section 3).
4. Weapons and the card numbers (sections 4 and 5).
5. Cosmetics (section 2), after part 1, since it reads the Starship's name.
```
